title: Next labels for scaling operations
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, define the next-label map on the scaling identifiers by sending $E$ to the first increment-check label for counter $E$, $F$ to the first clearing label, $E2$ to the corresponding first increment-check label for $E2$, $F2$ to the second clearing label, $In$ to the input-reading label, and $C$ to the first increment-check label for counter $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
